data_quality.reason: This ranking is ordered by recent star/PR/issue event counts, and our capture of those events fell to roughly 0.3% of baseline, so the ordering would be noise. An empty result here means the metric cannot be computed, not that there are no matching repositories.
data_quality.alternative: Current totals synced directly from GitHub remain accurate: use /v1/repos/{owner}/{repo} for star and fork counts, or /v1/collections/{id} for collection membership.
